body.heading: Where in the world is Ecuador?
paragraphs: Ecuador is a country in South America, which is part of South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Ecuador is Quito.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Ecuador is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Ecuador is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States! Ecuador uses US dollars — a traveller from the United States would recognise every note.

body.heading: How big is Ecuador?
paragraphs: Ecuador covers about 277,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Suriname.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Galápagos are nature's laboratory — giant tortoises, blue-footed boobies and marine iguanas that barely notice visitors, the islands that inspired Darwin.
Quito's UNESCO old town climbs Andean hills of churches; just north, the Mitad del Mundo monument lets you stand on the Equator line.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Ecuador on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
